### What are the 4 pillars of ethical AI?

The four pillars of ethical AI are fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy. Fairness ensures AI systems treat all individuals equitably without discriminatory bias. Transparency demands that algorithmic decision-making processes remain interpretable and explainable to stakeholders.
